correction: The Problems page (T857 t6) believed decoding a v1 integer field into json.Number checked its JSON type. Reality: json.Number also accepts a JSON string of digits, so "retries": "1" passed and the item became reportable. An integer field now must be a JSON number token (decodeNumber); other numbers and booleans decode into Go int, int64 or bool, which reject JSON text.
evidence: cross-review of the T857 t6 change; internal/problems.TestForgedValuesAreShownButNotReportable (retries as text), TestQuotedNumbersAndBooleansAreNotTrusted and TestDecodeNumber
